test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: general
question: The volume of a right circular cone is 308 cm³ and the radius of its base is 7 cm. What is the curved surface area (in cm²) of the cone? (Take π = (22)/(7) )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Height (h) = (3 × Volume) ÷ (π × r²)

h = (3 × 308) ÷ (22/7 × 7 × 7) = (3 × 308) ÷ 154 = 6 cm.

Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²) = √(7² + 6²) = √85 cm.

Curved Surface Area = πrl = (22/7) × 7 × √85 = 22√85 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 22√85 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume (V) = 308 cm³

Radius (r) = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²)

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = π × r × l

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b12836bed9e4223d6c786358067181f4d93fb485804122213838e233ab9742f2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 308 = (1/3) × (22/7) × 7 × 7 × h

⇒ 308 = (1/3) × 22 × 7 × h

⇒ 308 = (154/3) × h

⇒ h = (308 × 3) ÷ 154

⇒ h = 2 × 3 = 6 cm

⇒ l = √(7² + 6²)

⇒ l = √(49 + 36) = √85 cm

⇒ CSA = (22/7) × 7 × √85

⇒ CSA = 22√85 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 22√85 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cone

The total surface area (TSA) includes the CSA plus the area of the circular base: TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).

Slant Height Property

In a right circular cone, the height (h), radius (r), and slant height (l) always form a right-angled triangle, satisfying l² = r² + h².

Volume Relation

The volume of a cone is exactly one-third the volume of a cylinder having the same base radius and height.</p
